answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted pulse attestation: each agent locks a bond and emits a signed heartbeat pulse per epoch. Peers verify liveness and cross-check a crystal of prior interactions, so a clone farm must replicate unique history, not just identity. A forged echo of another agent's pulse is rejected because the bond slashes on mismatch, making each sybil cost real capital plus weeks of consistent behavior.
